title: PAR-134 MLEADERSTYLE CMC RGB retention
mode: generated AC1024 wire vectors plus six-version local DWG round-trip
scope: Retain the three R2004+ MLEADERSTYLE CMC RGB values specified by ODA §20.4.87
Independently inspect encoded CMC method and payload for each color field
Refuse invalid or pre-R2004 unrepresentable RGB before writing

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: Leader-line color group 91, text color group 93, and block color group 94 are each CMC fields. R2004+ CMC C2 carries a 24-bit RGB value; earlier encoding is index-only.

localSource.finding: The parser previously requested only normalized scalar colors and the writer always selected index-only CMC output. The model now appends a separate RGB companion per style color, retains C2 payloads, and emits C2 when RGB is present.
localSource.compatibility: New public fields follow all existing MLEADERSTYLE members, preserving prior member offsets while increasing class size. Consumers must rebuild; no vtable or callback changed. DXF color projection remains unchanged.

generatedControls.finding: An independent AC1024 bit walker checks three C2 CMC values, payloads, reserved indexes, flags, and field order, including RGB black 0. Negative cases cover each field's oversized RGB, inconsistent scalar/RGB state, and pre-R2004 RGB refusal. The local generated round-trip exercises parser retention for AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032.
generatedControls.limit: The generated data is local implementation evidence, not producer-authored or independent application semantics. No DXF truecolor group mapping or optional CMC name/book preservation is claimed.

productionSummary: Append leaderColorRgb, textColorRgb, and blockColorRgb with -1 absent sentinels.
Capture C2 RGB in bounded DWG parsing for all three documented MLEADERSTYLE color fields.
Write populated colors as C2, validate 24-bit and normalized-scalar invariants, and refuse RGB for pre-R2004 targets.
generatedTestSummary: Add libdxfrw_mleaderstyle_cmc_rgb focused CTest with independent method/payload wire inspection.
Exercise all three colors through the local six-version writer/reader matrix.
Keep older-version indexed paths and malformed RGB refusal covered.

commands.result: FAIL: one separate read-outcome-control assertion at stage 1; generated malformed-HATCH sentinel expected one entity parse failure but observed zero. No MLEADERSTYLE assertion failed in the six-version matrix.
